title: Muthis
summary: Muthis is named in Cory, Ancient Fragments (1876, ed. Hodges), with a reign length or synchronism. Display only.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 124; Manetho, ap. Syncellus, Chronicon 73 to 78, and Eusebius, Chronicle 16 and 17
reign.note: Not Musthis, the eighteenth Theban king in Eratosthenes, who is given 33 years.
